title: dpcisr_module_cpu row
description: One row per (kind, module, cpu) cell of the 'CPU Usage Summing By Module For the Whole Trace' tables in an xperf -a dpcisr report. Zero cells are rows. Schema 1.1.0 adds the driver class columns, which decode_dpcisr 1.2.0 always fills (docs/driver-classes.md).

driver_class.description: The driver class of the module (scripts/driver_classes.py); unclassified when nothing names one.

classification_source.description: inventory: the PC's driver_service_class table; inbox-map: the cited map of Microsoft inbox binaries; none: neither.

classification_reason.description: Why the class was given, in words, including what the inventory said when the inbox map decided.

classification_reference.description: For inbox-map, the Learn page of the entry; for inventory, <inventory bundle_id>/decoded/driver_service_class.jsonl#line:<n>[;line:<n>]; null for none.
